notes.title: Stacky Desktop Edition 1.0.0 released
notes.content:
Welcome everyone

Stacky Desktop Edition 1.0.0 is released!

A puzzle game about stacks. Arrange the stack on the left (working) to match the right stack (target) by using the available stack operations. 

Check the reference tab for how the stack operations work.
Some interesting puzzle solving awaits.

Have a good day!
